display.purpose: Page titles and major catalog headings.

body.purpose: Explanations, field content, and readable prose.

label.purpose: Navigation labels, metadata, and compact control text.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Cyan action button with tactile hard-edge hover feedback.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--a-color-ink); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--a-color-accent); color: var(--a-color-ink); font: inherit; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-button-primary:hover { transform: translate(-4px,-4px); box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--a-color-ink); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--a-color-ink); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Default Button
components.description: White bordered button for secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-button-default { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--a-color-ink); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--a-color-surface); color: var(--a-color-ink); font: inherit; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-button-default:hover { transform: translate(-4px,-4px); box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--a-color-ink); } .ds-button-default:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--a-color-ink); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Full-width field with explicit ink stroke and focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--a-color-ink); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--a-color-surface); color: var(--a-color-ink); font: inherit; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--a-color-secondary); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--a-color-ink); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Tag
components.description: Pill status label for compact semantic feedback.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 28px; padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--a-color-ink); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--a-color-surface); color: var(--a-color-ink); font: inherit; }

components.name: Navigation Row
components.description: Compact left-aligned catalog row with an outlined active state.
components.css: .ds-nav-row { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px; border-radius: 4px; color: var(--a-color-ink); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-row:hover { background: var(--a-color-surface); } .ds-nav-row[aria-current=page] { background: var(--a-color-surface); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--a-color-ink); font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Panel
components.description: Bordered working surface for previews, source, and workflows.
components.css: .ds-panel { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--a-color-ink); border-radius: 20px; background: var(--a-color-surface); } .ds-panel header { padding: 24px; background: var(--a-color-canvas); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--a-color-ink); font-weight: 600; } .ds-panel > div { padding: 24px; }

narrative.overview:
Brutalist Design System treats every component as a working specimen: clear enough to inspect, direct enough to copy, and tactile enough to reveal its behavior. The visual language is high-contrast and utilitarian, with a warm paper canvas, white working surfaces, black ink, and a bright cyan accent reserved for action and state.

The system favors readable density over decoration. Strong borders, compact radii, visible focus, and small offset shadows make interaction states legible. Documentation follows a categorized, AlignUI-inspired structure so vibe coders can move from preview to source to usable implementation without losing context.
keyCharacteristics: Black ink with cyan action accents
Compact radii, explicit borders, and offset depth

rules.name: The Small Palette Rule
rules.body: Use the accent and feedback colors for meaning; let ink, canvas, and surface carry most of the interface.

rules.name: The Specimen First Rule
rules.body: Show a readable working example before asking users to parse implementation details.

rules.name: The Hard Edge Rule
rules.body: Keep depth crisp and directional; do not introduce soft gradients or diffuse shadows into the core component language.

dos: Do use shared atomic primitives for controls, layout, and interaction behavior.
Do pair previews with copyable IDs or code wherever a developer needs to act.
Do preserve semantic names, keyboard access, and visible focus states.
Do use borders and offset shadows to explain structure and state.
donts: Don't replace reusable components with private screen-only controls.
Don't use accent colors as decoration without an interaction or status meaning.
Don't hide source examples behind fixed-height regions that clip wrapped code.
Don't introduce soft, diffuse elevation that conflicts with the hard-edge visual language.
